question: Can learned bounded episodic history improve twelve-step visual-action-consequence prediction after interference and across genuinely different partially observable MiniGrid task families, beyond a fully trained recurrent predictor, a current-observation conventional learner, persistence, and shuffled-history negative controls?
hypothesis: A 256-slot episodic causal-history learner trained solely on genuine MiniGrid environment observations and charged env.step outcomes will produce a >=0.0001 lower twelve-step future-observation/reward MSE than all preregistered controls in BOTH held-out DoorKey-8x8 and UnlockPickup, win >=9/12 independent world seeds per transfer family against the strongest trained control, and retain cold DoorKey prediction after a distinct interfering environment with <=10% relative MSE degradation. All training and evaluation observations remain partial and tokenless.

predecessor_evidence.note: T17 and IV18 procedural causal-memory gate development studies are scientifically negative. This successor changes physical environment family and task, never retunes their original data or source.

inputs.name: Farama Minigrid 3.2.0 MIT open-source wheel, PyPI verified
inputs.source: https://pypi.org/project/minigrid/3.2.0/; identical official simulator on both OS; no source modifications or reward shaping

inputs.name: Fresh prospective episode/seed manifest
inputs.source: Canonical JSON: schema yggdrasil.dg1-mg19-episode-plan.v1; train 630001..630012; interference 640001..640012; cold 650001..650012; transfer 660001..660012; larger 670001..670012; horizon 12; cap 128; five fixed arms.

frozen_design.dataset: Third-party Farama MiniGrid v3.2.0 actual gymnasium.make/reset/step environments. All models receive only official partial 7x7x3 image, discrete direction, previous action, and action-delayed outcome supervision derived strictly from future returned observation/reward; mission text excluded. Do not use env.unwrapped state/agent position/grid, hidden reward logic, oracle actions, counterfactual calls, or resets for training labels.

seeds.train: 630001..630012 inclusive, each on both training environments
seeds.cold: 650001..650012 evaluated twice without training on these episodes

frozen_design.chronology: Train on 24 DoorKey episodes, snapshot; evaluate read-only cold 12 seeds; train on 12 Dynamic-Obstacles interference episodes; restore snapshot for exact cold roundtrip probe, but retain actively interfered models; evaluate read-only the same cold seeds and 12 each unseen-size/new-family seeds. Never train on evaluation episodes; cold before and after evaluation both independently charge actual env.step calls.
frozen_design.policy: All episodes use a fixed precommitted observation-only exploration policy: front-cell key/box => pickup, front-cell door => toggle at bounded frequency, else forward/left/right chosen from local view and seeded RNG. No access to agent position, full map, mission text, hand-coded shortest-path solution or hidden action labels. All arms share identical charged trajectories.
frozen_design.prediction: At each time t, predict normalized visible counts at t+12 of wall, door, key, goal, empty, open-door and box, plus binary positive reward occurring within the subsequent 12 charged steps. Each prediction uses only current local image/direction/last action and at most 8 earlier observations/actions. Supervised labels from future returned env observations become trainable only after that 12-step delay. Transfer/cold labels are evaluator-only.
frozen_design.budget: 84 independent third-party environment episodes maximum 128 env.step calls each = 10,752 maximum charged actions, dynamically fewer if terminal. All five arms consume the same one generated trajectory, no per-arm environment replay or additional model/API calls. Zero evaluation training; exact charged counts plus per-split SHA-256 state/action/outcome traces and nonempty dynamic-event coverage reported.
frozen_design.model_capacity: Candidate and shuffled history: 256 records max with deterministic 256-slot reservoir, 8-step context of 12 input features, 8 output values. Trained current-observation SGD linear model (12x8 plus bias) and fully trained 8-hidden-unit recurrent sequence predictor (12x8 input, 8x8 recurrent, 8x8 readout plus biases), all weights updated from identical delayed labels; persistence zero-train control. Same fixed data and forecasts; no hidden model API.
frozen_design.evaluation: Compare average 8-output-vector MSE on 12-seed cold-before, cold-after, unseen-size and unseen-family splits. Also report 12-step event Brier, changed-visual-state coverage, 12 independent per-seed differences, cold pre/post ratio, memory retention, checkpoint size, per-split exact step counts, CPU; no extra training on scoring episodes.
frozen_design.determinism: Freeze Python 3.12, minigrid==3.2.0, gymnasium==1.4.0 and numpy==2.3.4; fix all RNG seeds. Numerical outputs/forecasts quantized to 8 decimal places and canonical checkpoints. Require exact per-split trajectory SHA and decision input hashes cross-platform, loss aggregates equal within 1e-8, checkpoint model numerical values equal within 1e-8 (byte-identical when serialized); otherwise INVALID_REPRO. Record full pip freeze and platform.
frozen_design.cold_checkpoint: Snapshot and restore each trained arm before evaluation; compare serialized snapshot, predictions on a synthetic toy probe and retained record counts. Strict no re-training on cold evaluated seeds or any transfer labels.
frozen_design.positive_coverage: Meaningful dynamic-transition coverage is >=5% of forecast windows with a change in normalized visible landmark counts between current and future image; require >=500 evaluation forecast windows across both transfer tasks. Lack of meaningful coverage classified INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE, never scientific failure.
frozen_design.original_firstuse_boundary: First commit includes prereg only. Implement and preflight on nonregistered toy seeds 11,17,19. First registered run only on PR opened; all subsequent workflow synchronizations skip original first-use.

controls.name: shuffled_history
controls.description: Equal-capacity episodic reservoir, same current-view features and labels; historical temporal context replaced with deterministic unrelated-context noise, as negative control.

controls.name: memoryless_sgd
controls.description: Fully trained conventional 12-input by 8-output linear SGD predictor, no past observations.

controls.name: recurrent_sgd
controls.description: Fully trainable 8-hidden-unit recurrent predictor, all input/recurrent/readout/bias matrices trained via bounded 8-step backpropagation through time on identical samples and fixed compute.

controls.name: persistence
controls.description: No-training conventional forecast: assume each future visual feature equals its currently observed value and reward is zero.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY iff complete custody and >=500 transfer forecast windows, meaningful dynamic coverage >=5%, candidate mean MSE on BOTH unseen-size and unseen-family <= min(memoryless_sgd,recurrent_sgd,persistence,shuffled_history)-0.0001, candidate individually beats best trained conventional recurrent/memoryless in >=9/12 seeds in each unseen split, cold-after MSE <= 1.10*cold-before MSE, candidate MSE cold-after <= min(recurrent_sgd,memoryless_sgd)-0.0001, reward Brier no worse than best trained conventional by >0.001, cold checkpoint within 65536 bytes, 100% audit read-only, CPU <=3x recurrent_sgd on each OS; exact episode identities and reproducibility. Even fully passing is DEV only, not native AGI or control acceptance.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV iff valid physical/portability/coverage but primary false, and candidate wins vs at least one registered comparator in one heldout split or retains episodic sample after interference and has equal-or-better cold MSE than its own baseline.
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV iff protocol/coverage valid, primary false, and no precommitted partial development signal.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE/INVALID_REPRO/INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE for dependency/source drift, absent real Minigrid env.step, seed/split or action accounting mismatch, identical-trace failure, eval label used in training, missing control training, cold snapshot corruption, mismatched exact trajectory hashes, >1e-8 cross-platform numerical loss/checkpoint discrepancies, insufficient >=500 transfer windows or <5% meaningful dynamic transition coverage. An unfavorable performance result with valid custody must remain NEGATIVE/MIXED, not infrastructure failure.

prohibited_after_primary_run: changing task splits, horizons, seeds, policy or source after first use
repeating original registered run on new source
declaring AGI or autonomous planning from forecasting score
preregistration_note: Commit this file alone before implementation and primary outcome. External research only; no loop, scheduled task, workstation, native model or deployment mutation.
